Court No. - 11
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4171 of 2022

Applicant :- Sarfaraj Ahmad Alias Sarfaraj S/O Sri Naffes Ahmad Alies Shakeel Ahmad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Home Lko.
And Others

Counsel for Applicant :- M.V.S. Chauhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sudhir Kumar,Sunil Kumar Verma
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State of U.P. and perused the
record.
2.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.98 of
2022, under Sections 376, 504, 506 and 354 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Pocso Act, Police
Station-Aashiyana, District-Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.
3.  The F.I.R. in question was lodged alleging that the applicant had developed physical relations with the victim on the false pretext of marriage.

The F.I.R. further records that the applicant the Sarfaraj Ahmad Alias Sarfaraj S/O Sri ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132869830/
1 victim have become friends on a social medial i.e. on Instagram and thereafter, the applicant used to promise the victim that he would marry her and subsequently, physical relations in between them were developed.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the applicant places on record a letter written by the victim, which is annexed as Annexure No.5 to this bail application, in which the victim herself has expressed the closeness with the applicant.
A supplementary affidavit, which is on record states that the victim as admitted the writing of the said letter, although, it is stated that it was done under threat.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of grant of bail to the applicant by arguing that applicant has developed physical intimacy with the victim on false pretext of marriage.

6. Considering the submissions made at the Bar and the fact that the fact witnesses have been examined and the applicant is in custody since 01.03.2022 and has no criminal antecedent coupled with the fact that there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant, if enlarged on bail can adversely affect the trial proceedings, as such, the applicant is enlarged on bail.
7. In view thereof, the present bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant-Sarfaraj Ahmad Alias Sarfaraj S/O Sri Naffes Ahmad Alies Shakeel Ahmad, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court on each date fixed,
either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the Trial Court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A IPC.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against him in accordance Sarfaraj Ahmad Alias Sarfaraj S/O Sri ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132869830/
2 with law.
